description: MABGP evaluation prompt set. Spans 8 sectors, 4 budget scales, physical and digital businesses, and 12 Indian localities. Held fixed so every arm of every experiment sees identical inputs.
design_notes: expect_operations records the routing outcome each prompt SHOULD produce; F58 uses it to verify the router before attributing token savings to it.
12 prompts omit a budget on purpose, to exercise the unspecified-budget path.
Localities are drawn from the F3 gazetteer so competitor lookups resolve; ground_truth_competitors is filled by hand for F55.
Prompt ids are stable: results across runs join on them.

ground_truth_competitors._comment: F55 Competitor Coverage Rate. For each prompt scored, count the real competing businesses within 2 km by hand (Google Maps, Justdial, a site visit) and list their names here. Coverage = |found ∩ actual| / |actual|. Leave a prompt out to exclude it from F55 rather than scoring it against a guess.
